title: Underground Arts

services.name: Party package
services.desc: Underground Arts is a unique and versatile venue in the heart of downtown Philadelphia, ideal for your next special event. Our two-room space accommodates up to 650 guests and can be customized to suit a wide range of occasions-including birthday parties, corporate gatherings, Bar/Bat Mitzvahs, weddings, class reunions, banquets, film screenings, and more. We offer both full venue buyouts and partial buyouts during scheduled concert nights. Please note: due to sound overlap between rooms, we are unable to host multiple events simultaneously. For all inquiries please fill out our questionnaire + drop us a line at privateevents@undergroundarts.org Our main room will fit up to 200 people fully
